theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (a : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (c : ℤ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → c ≠ 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, C' ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C a (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C' → ∀ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents C → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => (lams j)⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ x, g (dilation a (lams j) x) ∂R.measure) atTop (𝓝 ((c.natAbs : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x ∂μHE[n]))
